# Claude Code context pack

Working context for AI agents (mainly Claude Code, Path A) building Hanoi Artisan Bridge in
Sessions 8–11. Entry point: `CLAUDE.md` at the repo root. These files summarise; they never
override `docs/prd.md`, `docs/spec/`, `data/`, `AGENTS.md` or the constitution.

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `01-project-overview.md` | Product, roles, 7 modules, data package, known inconsistencies, team |
| `02-build-workflow.md` | Constitution, start_feature.py, 8-step loop with arguments, build log, MVP Alpha gates |
| `03-module-status.md` | Status board per module; AIT review round 2 findings and limitation rows |
| `04-bkg-brief.md` | BKG lifecycle, BR → test map, spec↔schema mapping, seed findings, slicing, stack |
| `05-review-playbook.md` | Step 7 verify procedure and PR report template |
| `06-lessons-learned.md` | Agent mistakes so far and how to prevent them |

Maintenance: update `03-module-status.md` and CLAUDE.md §5 whenever a PR is merged or a review
round ends. Changes to this folder go through a pull request like any other change.
